PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Senior Healthcare Business Analyst with 6+ years of experience across payer and provider domains, specializing in FHIR interoperability, HL7 integrations, EDI (837/835), ICD/CPT data mapping, CMS mandates, and HIPAA compliance. Strong expertise in data mapping, claims lifecycle, clinical workflows (EHR/EMR), and API integrations. Experienced in Agile (Scrum & SAFe) environments, including PI Planning and Scrum ceremonies, delivering scalable and compliant healthcare solutions.

CORE COMPETENCIES Payer Domain

EDI Transactions: 837 (P/I), 835, 270/271 Claims Lifecycle, Claims Adjudication & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) ICD-10 & CPT Coding Validation and Data Mapping CMS Interoperability Rule (CMS-0057-F) HIPAA Compliance FHIR API Provider Domain

● ● ● ● ●

● ● ●

EHR/EMR Workflows & Clinical Documentation HL7 v2 Messaging (ADT, ORM, ORU) Lab & Radiology Integration Patient Scheduling & Encounter Management

Interoperability & Data Mapping

● Data Mapping: HL7 ↔ EMR, EDI ↔ Database, ICD/CPT ↔ Claims Systems, FHIR JSON ↔ Legacy Systems ● API Integration & Validation (Postman)

FHIR Rest APIs : Patient, Observation, Encounter, Claim, Coverage, EOB

Tools & Technologies

Methodologies

Additional Knowledge



PHP, Blockchain, Generative AI, LLM

Senior Business Analyst/Scrum Master – Payer Domain |Webcom | 2024 – Present Project: CMS Patient Access API & Interoperability (FHIR)

● ● ● ● ●



Led implementation of FHIR-based Patient Access APIs to meet CMS-0057-F compliance Defined and documented requirements for FHIR resources: Patient, Claim, Coverage, EOB Performed data mapping between legacy payer systems and FHIR JSON structures Integrated ICD-10 and CPT coded data into FHIR Claim and EOB resources Conducted API testing and validation using Postman Facilitated Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives; proactively identified and resolved team impediments, dependencies, and blockers to ensure consistent sprint delivery. Collaborated with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, QA, and healthcare stakeholders to prioritize and refine the product backlog, track sprint progress, support PI Planning, and drive delivery of US Healthcare Payer/Provider initiatives.

● Wrote complex SQL queries for claims and member data validation ● ● ● Managed backlog in JIRA ● ● Outcome: ● ● ● Business Analyst – Payer Domain | Xchanging | 2023 – 2024 Project: EDI Claims Processing & Data Mapping (837/835)

● Wrote complex SQL queries for claims and member data validation ● ● ● Managed backlog in JIRA ● ● Outcome: ● ● ● Achieved CMS compliance ahead of deadline Improved member access to healthcare data by 40% Reduced API response errors by 15%

Actively participated in PI Planning sessions to align business priorities with technical delivery Facilitated Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Stand-ups, Retrospectives)

●

Gathered requirements for 837P and 837I claims processing systems



●

Designed end-to-end data mapping:



ICD-10 & CPT codes → Claims adjudication engine

Defined validation rules for claims submission and rejection handling (999, 277CA) Collaborated with clearinghouses to ensure seamless claims exchange

● Outcome: ● ●

Analyzed claims data using SQL to identify errors and improve processing Participated in Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, and Retrospectives

Increased claims acceptance rate by 25% Reduced coding-related denials significantly

Business Analyst – Provider Domain |Vara Infrovate | 2022 – 2023 Project: HL7 Integration & Clinical Data Exchange

● ● ● Worked with interface engine (Mirth) for message transformation and routing ● ● Outcome: ● ● Business Analyst – Provider Domain |Qwert Marketing| 2019 – 2022 Project: EHR Optimization & Clinical Workflow Enhancement

Implemented HL7 v2 integrations (ADT, ORM, ORU) across hospital systems Performed data mapping between HL7 segments (PID, OBX, PV1) and EMR database Integrated lab results and clinical observations into EHR system

● ● ● ● Outcome: ● ●

Gathered requirements to enhance EHR workflows and usability Designed modules for patient registration, encounters, and clinical documentation Integrated lab and radiology systems with EMR Used SQL for clinical reporting and operational insights Supported Agile delivery and participated in Scrum ceremonies

Improved clinician efficiency by 15% Reduced patient data retrieval time

Junior Business Analyst – Payer Domain |Deftsoft| 2017 – 2019 Project: ICD/CPT Coding Validation & Claims Adjudication

● ● ● ● Outcome: ● ●

Assisted in implementing ICD-10 and CPT coding validation rules Performed data mapping between coding systems and claims engine Identified discrepancies in coding impacting reimbursement Supported UAT and tracked defects in JIRA Ensured compliance with HIPAA and payer policies

Reduced claim denials by 18% Improved accuracy of coding and reimbursement

Associate Business Analyst – Provider Domain |Rudra Innovative| 2015 – 2017 Project: Agile Healthcare Application Development

● ● ● ● Outcome: ●

Created user stories and acceptance criteria for healthcare modules Assisted Product Owner in backlog management using JIRA and Trello Participated in Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) Supported API testing and requirement validation Contributed to successful sprint deliveries

Improved delivery timelines and reduced rework

EDUCATION M.Sc. in Computer Science [Kurukshetra University]

CERTIFICATIONS (Optional)

● ●

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) HL7 / FHIR Certification SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework)

Delivered FHIR-based CMS-compliant APIs Improved claims processing efficiency by 25% Reduced HL7 integration errors by 20% Strengthened ICD/CPT data mapping accuracy
